items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I know I hired him and Ben Webster and Coleman Hawkins (unintelligible) started a guest star thing.

ctx.x: Just as a person and as a musician. Because a lot of people don't know about him now.
Well, Ben Webster and Coleman Hawkins had the biggest tones in the business. Ben Webster had an even more oozing, soothing tone than Coleman Hawkins. Coleman was harsh.
